# FlowerDeliveryPK.com — Online Flowers & Luxury Gifts Delivery in Pakistan

> FlowerDeliveryPK.com is Pakistan's premier luxury florist and gift delivery service, providing hand-tied fresh bouquets, imported Dutch flowers, Belgian chocolate fudge cakes, velvet flower boxes, and curated hampers. We offer same-day chilled express delivery across Lahore, Karachi, Islamabad, Rawalpindi, and major Pakistani cities within 2–3 hours.

## Highlights & Service Guarantees
- **Live WhatsApp Video Guarantee**: Master florists record a live HD video of the completed bouquet and send it directly to WhatsApp before dispatch.
- **Express Same-Day Delivery**: Delivered within 2–3 hours in temperature-controlled chilled delivery vehicles.
- **Grade-A Hand-Selected Stems**: 100% farm-fresh Ecuadorian roses, Dutch hydrangeas, baby's breath, and sunflowers.
- **Overseas Customer Support**: Dedicated payment workflows for overseas Pakistanis in the UK, USA, UAE, Saudi Arabia, Canada, and Australia via Wise, Remitly, and international credit/debit cards.
- **Official WhatsApp Hotline**: +92 320 0411680 (0320-0411680)

- [Cakes & Flowers Combos](https://www.flowerdeliverypk.com/cake-and-flower-combos): Bakery fresh fudge cakes with luxury floral arrangements.
